title: Authorship Meter Declaration
description: Declares how a work was made across five process stages, on a five-level human-to-AI scale. Spec v1.1 adds provenance (assessed_at, subject.version) required for a declaration to be valid under SPEC.md §6.3.

url.description: Canonical location of the work — where a reader finds it.

source.description: Where the work and its declaration live (repo or project page). The per-instance declaration link (SPEC §6.2).

version.description: The state of the work this declaration describes — a git SHA, semver, or date. Required for v1.1 validity (scoped, SPEC §6.3).

updated.description: When the work was last materially changed. Compared against assessed_at for staleness detection (SPEC §6.3).

date.description: v1.0 field: date the work was completed. Superseded by subject.version/updated; kept for backward compatibility.

assessed_at.description: ISO date the declaration was made or last revised. Required for v1.1 validity (current, SPEC §6.3). Label as "Assessed", never "Validated" (SPEC §6.4).

level.description: Verification ceiling: level 5 is not declarable. A human always signs off.

weights.description: Optional per-stage weight overrides. Omit for equal weighting.

tools.description: Models or tools that materially contributed.

declared_by.description: Who made this declaration — the accountable owner. Recommended: surfaced on the card, not buried (SPEC §6.1).

method.description: How the declaration was arrived at. The primary trust signal — surfaced, not buried (SPEC §6.1). llm-assisted is the encouraged first-stage default (SPEC §1 principle 6).

history.description: Prior declarations, newest first, kept when the work is re-assessed after a material change (SPEC §7).

reason.description: What changed and why this entry was superseded.

level.description: 1 Human only · 2 Human-led, AI-assisted · 3 Co-created · 4 AI-led, human-directed · 5 AI-generated

note.description: One concrete sentence describing what happened at this stage.
